Four NVIDIA RTX 6000 Ada Generation cards with the datasheet's Ada architecture, compute capability 8.9, 18,176 CUDA cores, 300 W board power and 48 GB of GDDR6, read as a v1 total of 48 GiB (a real card reports a little less)
Each card's v1 used is its one worker's usedGpuMemory plus 512 MiB the driver reserves, and free is total less used
One vLLM tensor-parallel worker per card (pids 41240, 41243, 41246, 41249) holding about 40.4 GiB each, about 161.6 GiB in all, more than the 43.5 GiB of system memory in use
The workers' /proc/<pid>/stat values and cmdline, which is vLLM's process title VLLM::Worker_TP<i> (comm cut to 15 characters)
Every /proc/meminfo value: 251 GiB of RAM, as ws1 in the demo, with AnonPages, Shmem and the kernel's share all inside the memory in use
Every clock, temperature, threshold, power, energy, utilisation, fan, PCIe and violation reading
ECC on; the driver 580.95.05, CUDA 13.0 and NVML 13.580.95.05, as ws1 in the demo
nvmlDeviceGetProcessUtilization answers NOT_FOUND: no sample is newer than timestamp 0

sources./usr/local/cuda-13.0/targets/sbsa-linux/: nvmlMemory_t (v1): total = free + used, and used is reserved plus allocated
nvmlMemory_v2_t takes reserved out of used; the agent reads v1
BAR1, the CPU-visible aperture onto VRAM: its use is not VRAM use, so the agent does not read it
nvmlProcessInfo_t: usedGpuMemory, and instance ids of 0xFFFFFFFF outside MIG
nvmlDeviceGetMemoryInfo, for all products: NOT_SUPPORTED on an iGPU without a framebuffer, NO_PERMISSION in MIG mode without privilege
nvmlDeviceGetComputeRunningProcesses: usedGpuMemory is all the memory the application uses
nvmlDeviceGetProcessUtilization: NOT_FOUND when no sample is newer
